live_audit_2026_09_18.interpretation: The retained statistical rows used by the model reconcile exactly with the 2026-09-18 live official-source fetch. The BIS transport XML is not byte-identical to the historical raw response; current BIS XML contains response-level identifiers and preparation/extraction timestamps, so a raw-envelope mismatch alone is not treated as evidence of a changed normalized policy-rate series.

vintages.reason: v0.1.0 retained all four raw SHA-256 digests but not the raw payloads. Three ECB payloads were recovered on 2026-09-18 because their live responses were byte-identical to the legacy hashes. The BIS raw response did not match and is therefore not relabelled as the historical payload.
vintages.recovery_rule: Do not claim complete exact raw-vintage reproducibility unless the missing BIS historical payload is independently recovered with its recorded SHA-256. The normalized statistical inputs are separately reconciled and must not be conflated with raw transport-envelope reproducibility.
